# Fraser Valley Floors

> Fraser Valley Floors provides residential and commercial flooring, epoxy floor coatings, and concrete resurfacing across Fraser Valley, British Columbia. The company serves Abbotsford, Surrey, Delta, Langley, Chilliwack, Maple Ridge, Mission, and surrounding communities.

Fraser Valley Floors offers flooring installation, concrete coating systems, floor preparation, and floor demolition. Customers can request a free, no-obligation estimate by phone or through the website contact form.

- Website: https://www.fraservalleyfloors.com/
- Contact: https://www.fraservalleyfloors.com/contact
- Phone: (778) 562-5420
- Email: info@fraservalleyfloors.com
- Service area: Fraser Valley, British Columbia, Canada
- Hours: Available 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Sitemap: https://www.fraservalleyfloors.com/sitemap.xml

## Frequently asked questions

### How long does an installation take?

Most residential projects are completed within 1–3 days. Larger commercial installations are scheduled with detailed timelines after a free on-site assessment.

### Are installations covered by a warranty?

Yes. Every installation is backed by a manufacturer warranty plus a workmanship guarantee.

### How can a customer get a quote?

Call Fraser Valley Floors or complete the quote form at https://www.fraservalleyfloors.com/contact for a free, no-obligation estimate with written pricing.
